requirements.name: go-stdlib-module
requirements.text: Implement in Go 1.22 or newer using only the standard library. The application root is a Go module, and its executable is the main package at `./cmd/ddkstat`. Tests run under `go test`.

requirements.name: run-harness
requirements.text:
The harness runs `go build -o <temporary path> ./cmd/ddkstat` and then runs 20 checks against
`sources/llm_sample.jsonl`. Each check compares one command's exit code and standard output with a
known answer.

requirements.name: command-line-syntax
requirements.text:
`<report>` comes first, options follow it, and the log path is last. Exactly one log path is
required. `<report>` is one of `summary`, `commands`, `targets`, `models`, `daily`, `failures`.

requirements.name: target-filter
requirements.text: Keep only records whose `job.target` equals `<name>` exactly.

requirements.name: date-filters
requirements.text: Keep only records whose start date is on or after `<date>`.

requirements.name: date-option-validation
requirements.text: A date option must be a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`.

requirements.name: read-jsonl-log
requirements.text:
The log is JSON Lines in UTF-8: one JSON object per line. A record carries many fields. The
reporter reads only these and ignores every other field:

requirements.name: blank-lines
requirements.text: **Blank lines** are ignored and not counted.

requirements.name: skipped-lines
requirements.text:
**Skipped lines.** A line is skipped when it is not a JSON object, when any of `execution_id`,
`started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, or `job.target` is absent or not a non-empty
string, or when its `execution_id` already appeared on an earlier line. The first occurrence of
an `execution_id` is kept. Each skipped line writes one warning to standard error naming its
line number. Skipping never changes the exit code.

requirements.name: missing-numbers
requirements.text:
**Missing numbers.** An absent or `null` token count, cost, or duration counts as zero. A
record with no `result.stats` object at all is still a record.

requirements.name: record-model
requirements.text:
**Model.** A record's model is `result.stats.model` when present and non-empty, otherwise
`job.model`.

requirements.name: failed-record
requirements.text: **Failed.** A record is failed when `status` is not `succeeded`.

requirements.name: filters-apply-to-all
requirements.text:
**Filters** apply to every report. The `skipped` count in `summary` counts skipped lines in the
whole file regardless of filters.

requirements.name: minutes-format
requirements.text:
**Minutes.** A minutes column is the group's summed `elapsed_ms` written in tenths of a minute:
`t = (ms + 3000) / 6000` in integer division, written as `t / 10`, a `.`, and `t % 10`.
`95000` ms is `1.6`.

requirements.name: cost-format
requirements.text:
**Cost.** A cost column is the group's summed `cost_usd` written with exactly four decimal
places, as Go's `%.4f` writes a `float64`.

requirements.name: byte-ordering
requirements.text: **Ordering.** Text is compared by byte value.

requirements.name: csv-output
requirements.text:
Every report writes CSV to standard output: one header row, then data rows, comma-separated, `\n`
line endings. Every report except `summary` and `failures` ends with a `TOTAL` row over all
filtered records. When no record matches, a report writes its header and, where it has one, a
`TOTAL` row of zeros (`0.0` minutes, `0.0000` cost).

requirements.name: summary-report
requirements.text: `records,skipped,succeeded,failed,first,last,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes` | One row. `first` and `last` are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.

requirements.name: commands-report
requirements.text: `command,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,minutes` | One per command, by calls descending, then command ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: targets-report
requirements.text: `target,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,minutes` | One per Target, by Target ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: models-report
requirements.text: `provider,model,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd` | One per provider and model pair, by provider then model ascending. Then `TOTAL,,…`.

requirements.name: daily-report
requirements.text: `date,calls,failed,tokens,minutes` | One per start date, ascending. `tokens` is input plus cached plus output. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: failures-report
requirements.text: `started_at,target,command,model,returncode,timed_out` | One per failed record, by `started_at` then `execution_id` ascending. `returncode` is empty when `null` or absent. `timed_out` is `true` or `false`.

requirements.name: failure-diagnostics
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: exit-codes
requirements.text:
| `0` | Success, including a log with skipped lines or no matching records. |
| `1` | Operational failure: the log cannot be opened or read. |
| `2` | Usage error: unknown report or option, missing option value, invalid date, missing or extra log path. |

requirements.name: test-script
requirements.text:
The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs `go vet ./...` and
`go test ./...` from the application root and exits zero only when both pass. The suite covers
each report, each filter, each skip rule, and each exit code using logs written by the tests.

requirements.name: build-go-executable
requirements.text: Builds ./cmd/ddkstat with `go build` and compares every report's exit code and standard output

requirements.name: summary-report
requirements.text: check A1 0 summary "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: commands-report
requirements.text: check A2 0 commands "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: targets-report
requirements.text: check A3 0 targets "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: models-report
requirements.text: check A4 0 models "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: daily-report
requirements.text: check A5 0 daily "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: failures-report
requirements.text: check A6 0 failures "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: skip-bad-lines
requirements.text: Standard error is never compared.

requirements.name: filter-by-target
requirements.text: check B1 0 summary --target Toml --since 2026-10-15 "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: filter-by-date-range
requirements.text: check B3 0 daily --since 2026-10-15 --until 2026-10-15 "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: empty-filter-result
requirements.text: check C1 0 commands --target NoSuchTarget "$LOG" <<'EOF'

requirements.name: missing-log-exit-1
requirements.text: check E1 1 summary "$MISSING" < /dev/null

requirements.name: usage-errors-exit-2
requirements.text: check U1 2 < /dev/null

requirements.name: grader-passes-all
requirements.text: Exit 0 only when the build succeeds and every check passes.
